scope: Ordinary coach direct player-card prediction. Reward remains separate. The frozen baseline and the frozen x59 predictions are not modified.

structuralChange.hypothesis: The coach multiplier transfers N-1 effective dose units, not N.
structuralChange.law: B_lo = C * A(age) * (N - multiplierOffset) / p; B_hi = upperDoseRatio * B_lo
structuralChange.multiplierOffset: fixed a priori at 1 (integer); not fitted
unchanged: tier additions and u = s - Delta(T) for WHITE, u = s for MID_GREY
flat-to-exponential response with class thresholds 132.6 / 120.1 and K = 26.05
upper dose ratio 1.529 and rectification at zero
equal allocation across the p displayed affected stats

dose.amplitudeCalibrationPartition: All complete ordinary previews except canonical-workbook ORDINARY COACH (HIST) records and the frozen 24 Sep Standard Safeguard x59 prospective test. One parameter fitted by endpoint least squares with the response frozen.

optionalCoachAnchor.rule: If an observed preview of the identical coach definition (programme family, label, multiplier, affected-stat count and affected-stat set) exists for a DIFFERENT player, the coach's log dose offset is estimated from those other players' previews only and added to log C for the target. The target player's own previews are never used. Without such an anchor the primary card + metadata prediction is used unchanged.
optionalCoachAnchor.reason: Implied dose varies by coach definition beyond family, shape, N and p; no stable player-level factor is detectable.

evidenceBoundary: Canonical-workbook ORDINARY COACH records are scored but never fitted: they fail dose-free geometric admissibility or carry degenerate/conflicting state provenance.
The frozen x59 predictions remain the baseline's prospective record; this candidate's x59 score is out of sample because C was fitted without it.
No player-specific amplitude is fitted from any observed outcome.
